name: Editorial
note: Magazine columns and big display type.
thesis: A printed design magazine on warm paper: ink-black serif display type, justified multi-column body with drop caps, mono folios and standfirsts, hairline + heavy rules, and a single oxblood accent — restraint and reading rhythm over decoration.

tokens.bg: #f6f2e9 warm newsprint (radial highlight to #fbf8f1 at top); recessed panels #efe9db
tokens.accent: #9b2226 oxblood/rose (deep #7d1c1f); used only for kickers, drop cap, rules, links, hover
tokens.fontDisplay: serif stack — Iowan Old Style / Palatino / Book Antiqua / Georgia (weights 700–800, italic for accents)
tokens.fontMono: var(--font-mono) Geist Mono — folios, kickers, metadata, buttons, all-caps tracked labels
tokens.radius: 0 everywhere — print has no rounded corners; even Avatars and Badges are squared off
tokens.border: 1px hairline #d8cfbe for rules/dividers; 2–3px heavy ink #2a2620 for masthead/section/table-head rules; double-rule under masthead
tokens.motion: minimal — 200ms ease-out color/background only on hover; no transforms, no shadows except a 6px offset 'print' shadow on the letterbox card

layout: Single 1140px centered column with a running head (breadcrumb + folio line). A centered masthead wordmark bracketed by single+double ink rules. The cover is a 1.55fr/1fr split: left = kicker, big serif display headline with one italic oxblood word, dek, mono byline, then a justified 2-column body with a drop cap and a footnote superscript; right = a bordered 'In this issue' contents panel listing features with folio page numbers and three stat figures. Each subsequent section is a horizontal band separated by a 1px top rule, introduced by a mono 'department mark' (small-caps label + short accent rule) and a serif section title. Features are a ruled vertical feed (folio | title+dek | right-aligned mono meta). Departments use a 2-column ruled grid inside underline Tabs. Awards are a 1.6fr/1fr split of a ruled Table ledger + a contributors/press sidebar. Letters is a 1fr/1fr split of brief intro + a 'letterbox' Card. Closes with a colophon: heavy rule, brand + nav links, numbered footnotes, back-link.

sections.name: running-head + masthead
sections.what: Breadcrumb trail and a price/issue folio line, then a centered magazine wordmark with a single rule above and a printer's double-rule below, plus a mono subtitle row (publication / cities / est.).
sections.restyle: Breadcrumbs flattened to mono uppercase 11px in muted ink; the wordmark and rules are hand-rolled type/CSS, not a component.

sections.name: cover (hero + manifesto)
sections.what: Kicker badge, big serif display headline with one italic oxblood word, a dek, a mono byline rule, a justified 2-column manifesto with a drop cap and a footnote ref, and two CTA buttons. Right column is a bordered contents/issue index with page folios + stat figures.
sections.restyle: Badge stripped of fill/border to become a flush mono kicker; Buttons squared to ink-fill and ghost-outline with mono all-caps labels; columns/drop-cap/footnote are pure CSS (CSS columns + ::first-letter).

sections.name: pull-quote
sections.what: A full-width centered italic serif pull-quote bracketed by 3px ink rules top and bottom, with a quote glyph and a mono attribution line.
sections.restyle: Callout's panel chrome (bg, border, radius, padding) zeroed and rebuilt as an open top/bottom-ruled pull-quote; its icon slot holds a lucide Quote tinted oxblood.

sections.name: features
sections.what: A ruled vertical feed of selected work read as magazine features: oxblood folio page number, kicker, serif title (turns oxblood on hover), dek, and right-aligned mono discipline/year/pages with a 'Read ↗'. Pagination below.
sections.restyle: Each row is a stretched-link list item (one Inertia Link covering the row, no nested anchors); Pagination buttons squared with mono numerals.

sections.name: departments (capabilities)
sections.what: Underline Tabs (Services / Editorial process / Letters): a 2-column ruled grid of services with italic roman-numeral markers, a process Timeline, and an FAQ Accordion.
sections.restyle: Tab triggers → mono all-caps over a 2px ink rule with oxblood active state; Timeline + Accordion typography overridden to serif body / mono dates; service numerals set in italic serif oxblood.

sections.name: masthead (team)
sections.what: Four people in a ruled 4-up grid: squared monogram avatar, serif name, mono all-caps role.
sections.restyle: Avatar de-rounded to a square ink plate with mono initials — a printer's nameplate, not a profile chip.

sections.name: recognition (awards + contributors)
sections.what: A ruled awards Table ledger (Year / Feature / Citation) beside a sidebar of contributor tags and an in-the-press list.
sections.restyle: Table rebuilt as an accountant's ledger — transparent rows, hairline row rules, 2px ink header rule, mono oxblood years, serif body; Badges → squared outline mono contributor tags.

sections.name: letters (contact / brief)
sections.what: Left: intro, mono address lines, an indicative-budget range slider with a ReasonTag explainer. Right: a 'letterbox' Card with a Composer, a character Progress bar, and a send button; success state swaps to a received note.
sections.restyle: Card squared with a 6px offset 'print' drop shadow and ink-rule header/footer; Composer squared on paper with serif body; the budget control is a hand-rolled squared range slider (native MoodMeter avoided to keep the print feel); ReasonTag kept in underline theme.

sections.name: colophon
sections.what: Heavy rule, brand blurb + uppercase mono nav links, a numbered footnotes list, and a folio line + back-to-gallery link.
sections.restyle: Footnotes are a hand-rolled numbered list with oxblood mono indices; back-link is mono all-caps oxblood.

palette.restyle: Squared (radius 0), no shadow, mono all-caps tracked label. Two variants: ink-fill (black → oxblood on hover) and ghost (ink hairline outline → oxblood text+border on hover).
Two reads: stripped to a flush mono oxblood kicker (cover), or squared outline mono uppercase 'contributor tag' (recognition). Loses pill shape and fill entirely.
Chrome removed; reborn as an open pull-quote bracketed by 3px ink rules, centered italic serif, with the icon slot tinting a Quote glyph oxblood.
Becomes a ruled ledger: transparent cells, hairline row dividers, a 2px ink header rule, mono uppercase column heads, mono oxblood years, serif body, bold ink feature names.
Underline variant; triggers set in mono all-caps over a heavy 2px ink rule, muted by default, oxblood when active — a section rail, not buttons.
De-rounded to a square ink nameplate with mono initials in paper-white — type-foundry monogram instead of a round photo chip.
Triggers in bold serif (a Q&A 'letters' column); answers in serif body — reads as set type, not UI.
Dates pushed to mono uppercase muted ink; titles/descriptions to serif; oxblood dots for milestone steps.
Squared on warm paper with a hairline border and serif input text — a typewriter sheet in the letterbox card.
Thin oxblood bar reading as a 'column inches set' meter under the letter composer.
Squared buttons, mono numerals — page folios at the foot of the features feed.
Underline theme so the budget figure reads like an editor's marginal note with a dotted underline.
Flattened to a mono uppercase running-head trail in muted ink, oxblood on hover.
Rules dropped to hairline paper tone; Headings forced to the serif display stack; Text/Tooltip recolored to ink/mono to match set type.

contentArchetype: A fictional design + dev studio (FIELDWORK) presenting its one-page portfolio as a quarterly design magazine — masthead, contents/issue index, cover manifesto, selected work as 'features' with page folios, a pull-quote house-style line, departments (services/process/FAQ), the team as a 'masthead', an awards ledger + contributors, a 'letters to the editor' contact box, and a colophon with footnotes.
remix: Swap the oxblood for any single ink-friendly spot color (forest, navy, plum) and the warm paper for a cooler off-white to reskin the whole language. To blend toward a different style: keep the multi-column drop-cap body + folio/mono metadata system but trade the serif for a grotesque to move toward Swiss/editorial-modern; drop the paper texture and double rules and raise contrast for a stark editorial-noir. The load-bearing moves are: (1) serif display + mono metadata pairing, (2) radius 0 + hairline/heavy rule system, (3) CSS multi-column justified body with a drop cap, (4) a single restrained spot accent. Any Fancy primitive can be poured into it by zeroing its chrome (bg/border/radius) and reassigning its type to the serif/mono pair.
